Contact

How to reach Couple Better Gifts with questions, corrections, or partnership requests.

Questions, corrections, or partnership requests can be sent to couplebettergifts@gmail.com. Tell us which page or gift you are writing about.

Orders and returns

We do not sell products directly. For an order, delivery, or return, contact the store where you bought the gift. Your order confirmation email names the store.

Corrections

If a product link is broken or a buying guide has an error, send the page address and what needs fixing. We review the guides and update the date at the top of each page when we change them.
